request.description: Creates a shipment and saves orderId for the following requests.
Returns the order saved in PostgreSQL without contacting the courier.
Gets current tracking information from the courier and saves new events.
Cancels the shipment. No request body is required.
Queues a shipment batch and saves batchId from the 202 response. The worker must be running.
Returns batch progress and per-order results.
Checks pincode availability using the configured default courier.
